name: Accordion Servo MIDI
summary: Automated acoustic accordion concept using servo-operated reed valves and a stepper-driven bellows.

notes: Current documented firmware targets ATmega32U4 boards; ESP32 migration is not yet the active implementation.

transports.notes: Native USB MIDI is available as an optional build profile.

notes: General-Midi-Boop currently lists Accordion-servo-midi in its future compatibility section.

mechanics.summary: Fifty-nine servos open reed valves while a NEMA17 stepper moves the bellows through a linear transmission; end stops provide homing and travel protection.
notes: Repository notes that 2D wood plans, 3D/STL parts and a complete material list are still TODO.

actuators.notes: README describes a NEMA17 and TMC2209.

notes: Repository notes that independent PCA OE control and bank-level servo power switching still need improvement.

warnings: Repository explicitly states that the code/mechanism has not been validated on the real accordion and lists several hardware improvements still required.
